name: The school corridor (Knightsbrook International School), evaluation room 2
setting: Cosy, warm and tidy: the main corridor of a Singapore international primary school in the afternoon, empty of people.
palette: the walls are cream above a pale mint band; the band's top edge is at a child's shoulder height, 42% of the way up the back wall from the floor; the floor is pale grey vinyl with a faint sheen; accents teal and purple
box: a shallow box in one-point perspective: a wide back wall running the full width, narrow side walls, a thin strip of ceiling, a low floor band
light: the only daylight comes through the open doorway to the hall on the notice-board wall, with soft even light from the ceiling elsewhere

h1.name: the lockers wall (north)
h1.light: soft even light; the doorway to the hall is behind the viewer to the right, so a faint warm glow falls on the right-hand end of this wall and shadows lean gently left

objects.label: row of lockers
objects.text: a row of eight tall pale-blue metal lockers side by side, each with a small vent and a round handle; the third locker from the left is purple and has no door at all, its inside bare and empty
objects.size: the lockers reach well above a child's head, their tops a little above the mint band

objects.label: wooden bench
objects.text: a low wooden bench with nothing on it

objects.label: drinking fountain
objects.text: a small cream drinking fountain on the wall with a steel basin
objects.size: its basin at a child's chest height

h2.name: the library doors wall (east), to the right of the lockers wall
h2.light: soft even light; the doorway to the hall is to the right of this wall, so a warm glow comes from the right and shadows lean left

objects.label: framed blank poster
objects.text: a framed poster on the wall with a plain pale picture of a moth and no words

objects.label: LIBRARY double doors
objects.text: a pair of pale wooden double doors, closed, each with a round porthole window, and above them a small sign reading LIBRARY
objects.size: the doors reach almost to the ceiling strip

objects.label: tall plant
objects.text: a tall leafy plant in a plain terracotta pot standing on the floor

h3.name: the notice-board wall (south), opposite the lockers wall
h3.light: daylight pours through the open doorway to the hall in the middle of this wall and lies in a bright patch on the floor in front of it; the rest of the wall is in soft even light

objects.label: cork notice board
objects.text: a large cork notice board with a wooden frame, a few blank white papers pinned to it, nothing written on any of them

objects.label: open doorway to the HALL
objects.text: a wide open doorway with no door in it, a small sign reading HALL above, and through it a glimpse of a bright sunlit hall with a polished wooden floor and a far wall of tall windows
objects.size: the doorway reaches almost to the ceiling strip

objects.label: wooden bench
objects.text: a low wooden bench with nothing on it

h4.name: the classroom doorways wall (west), to the left of the lockers wall
h4.light: soft even light; the doorway to the hall is to the left of this wall, so a warm glow comes from the left and shadows lean right

objects.label: open doorway to Classroom 5H
objects.text: an open doorway with no door in it, and through it a glimpse of a classroom: a cream wall with a mint band, the corner of a whiteboard
objects.size: the doorway reaches almost to the ceiling strip

objects.label: coat pegs with two bags
objects.text: a wooden rail of coat pegs on the wall with two small school bags hanging from it, one purple and one teal
objects.size: the rail at a child's eye height

objects.label: open doorway to the art room
objects.text: an open doorway with no door in it, and through it a glimpse of an art room: a paint-splashed sink and a shelf of paint pots
objects.size: the doorway reaches almost to the ceiling strip
